name: Karumai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Karumai town emblem in white: two interlocking crescents forming a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Karumai, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1957.

features.role: Karumai town emblem — two interlocking crescents forming a ring
